description: A CRUD-heavy users board in the Svelte 5 data grid. Role and status are list editors and MFA a checkbox, every edit lands in a live audit log in the side panel, ticking rows reveals a toolbar for Activate, Deactivate, Delete and Export, an Invite user dialog validates name, email and role and inserts a new user with a pending status, and clicking a row shows a permissions matrix per resource plus the user's activity feed.

faq.question: How are inline edits captured for the audit log?
faq.answer: onCellValueChange receives the row, column, old and new value and appends an entry with the acting admin, a severity and a timestamp. The side panel lists the newest entries from that array.

faq.question: How do bulk actions know the selection?
faq.answer: The checkbox column keeps a selected set in state; the toolbar enables when it is non-empty and maps over the selected ids to update or remove users.

faq.question: How is a new user added?
faq.answer: The invite dialog validates its fields and prepends a user object with a pending status to the array; the status cell renders it as a pending pill until an admin activates it.
